text: Honestly, I think I read too much sci fi as a kid and I feel like this world is very familiar to me. I think storytelling is so important in getting people to change their minds. So I really make it a point of starting where the person is starting from. I explain to them the history of how technology has transformed our industry. We began to use computers to improve the way that we did stock trading and then bond trading. When the Internet came along, we began to open up proprietary systems and allow more functionality to be self serve. And I explain how now we are seeing this new set of technologies that improves the way that we do record keeping, that creates a more secure ledger, that decentralizes and distributes key functions so that there's less opportunity for fraud. And then once I've convinced them about all of the benefits of how the technology works, then I start to talk about the fact that if I told you that all these technologies were there, you would be buying these companies hand over fist to own them. So Lana and your peers are going to be the ledgers of the world. And once you are the ledgers of the world, and the world is running on your block, you are the ecosystem that the world operates upon. I have seen how technology has transformed my life over and over and over. And so I am an optimist, because every new technology that has come out has made the industry better, more knowledgeable, more open and more accessible.
speaker: A
